Dutiyaanudhammasutta In Line With the Teaching (2nd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Dhammānudhammappaṭipannassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ayamanudhammo hoti yaṁ rūpe aniccānupassī vihareyya …pe… “Mendicants, when a mendicant is practicing in line with the teaching, this is what’s in line with the teaching. They should meditate observing impermanence in form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness. … ‘parimuccati dukkhasmā’ti vadāmī”ti. They’re freed from suffering, I say.”

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
